annotations.reason_zh: 摘要明确将成对约束传播形式化为低秩矩阵恢复问题，显式利用低秩矩阵恢复/近似结构。

annotations.exact_quote: not only completes the unknown entries in the constraint matrix but also removes the noise from the data matrix

annotations.exact_quote: As a kind of weaker supervisory information, pairwise constraints can be exploited to guide the data analysis process
